scope_note: Built and tested in this repository on 2026-10-07 from the research in docs/research/monetization-ads-store-2026-10.md; every cited path exists here.
title: Shop, store art, store page and ads plan for every game
summary: monetize.py plans a genre's full shop (passes, developer products, a subscription, offers, boosts, perks and the shop layout) in setup mode with suggested prices only in the owner's sheet; GameKit Offers, Boosts, Perks and ShopLayout run it without prompting; store_art.py composes and lints icons, thumbnails and item icons; store_page.py drafts and lints the title and description; ad_kit.py writes an Ads Manager plan that never purchases. Release check A18 requires the shop plan and a clean store page.
limitations: Developer-product prices come from third-party guides; game-pass prices were read live on 2026-10-07.
Some ad benchmarks (credit price in USD, CTR target, country tiers) are community reports.
Creating products, setting prices, uploading art and buying ads stay with the owner.
